title: Path on map
description: An ordered path (a race lap, a route, a track) drawn on the street map with 3D buildings, coloured by an optional value per point, with a start/finish marker.

path.description: The path's points, in order. A list of ZQL Point values or [lon, lat] pairs. The first point is the start/finish.

value.description: One number per point (speed, distance, sector…). Each segment takes the colour of its start point's value.

label.description: A name shown at the start/finish marker.

bounds.description: [west, south, east, north] to frame; null frames the path.

basemap.description: Which street-map archive to draw under the path. auto picks the one that covers it.

colorScale.description: sequential: one hue, light to dark with the value. diverging: two hues around the value's midpoint. solid: the accent colour, value ignored.

view.description: 2d looks straight down; 3d tilts the camera (pitch 60°) so buildings stand up.

bearing.description: Camera bearing in degrees, clockwise from north.

showBuildings.description: Extrude buildings to their OSM heights.
